escalations.detail: Two findings (cf-c-anom_5, agent-a2-f22) claim ajax_nopriv or no-auth for an endpoint that gate scoring marks as privileged (auth_consistent low). Conflict between claimed auth level and gate evidence is unresolved at the merge layer.

merge_stats.notes: Three findings (cartflows-a1-001, agent-a2-f22, cf-c-anom_5) describe overlapping upload sinks at checkout-ajax.php lines 308/311/425. Counting these as one conflict cluster over 6 findings yields conflict_rate at 50% threshold. Agent-b absence independently triggers escalation.

spot_checks.notes: Reasoning documents trace from render_html (block:856) through include at class-cartflows-checkout-markup.php:533. Structure is internally consistent and refutation attempt is explicit. Verdict REVIEW (uncertain exploitability) is supported by gate scores (path_reachable=0.25, auth_consistent=0.25). Warn on reference plausibility: block:856 is an unusual line reference for a block render function and is unverifiable without source access. Not a disqualifier. Agent correctly did not promote to CONFIRMED given unknown auth level. S5 assessment: reasoning quality acceptable for REVIEW verdict.

Reasoning_score=0.52 is below threshold for a CRITICAL claim. CRITICAL severity is not supported when foundational auth assumption is unverified. Hard conflict with agent-a2-f22 over the same sink region. REVIEW verdict is appropriate. No further escalation beyond what Session 26 applied.

Sink claimed at checkout-ajax.php:325 but code_evidence=0.25 — gate could not find wp_handle_upload near that line. A CRITICAL verdict with missing sink reference is a process failure. Reasoning_score=0.52. Session 26 downgrade to REVIEW is appropriate and should hold. Reopening condition: locate confirmed wp_handle_upload invocation at or near line 325 with confirmed nopriv hook registration in actual source.

Structured reasoning with explicit file/line references (checkout-ajax.php:311, :425). Refutation documented: extension allowlist and nonce bypass addressed. Correctly bounds impact to arbitrary media upload, not RCE. Warn: path_reachable=0.25 leaves actual call-path unconfirmed. Semgrep=1.0 is Tier 4 (supporting only). Reasonable as UNCERTAIN; should not advance to CONFIRMED without path_reachable resolution.

Strongest gate profile in the set: code_evidence=1.0, guard_consistent=0.9, reasoning=0.87. Distinguishable success/fail response text at confirmed lines is a coherent, bounded claim. Refutation documented. Low severity is appropriately calibrated. Closest to actionable in the entire cartflows uncertain set. Path_reachable=0.25 remains a blocker (same root cause as DI-27-01 shallow extraction).

conflict_resolutions.conflict: Overlapping upload sink — three findings describe wp_handle_upload in same function region at different lines
findings_involved: agent-a2-f22-upload-checkout-file (line 425, medium, auth claimed none but gate says priv)
cf-c-anom_5 (line 308, CRITICAL, auth claimed none but gate says priv)
conflict_resolutions.resolution: Cannot resolve at S5 layer. Three findings disagree on: (a) precise sink line (308 vs 311 vs 425), (b) hook registration type (nopriv vs priv), and (c) severity (medium vs CRITICAL). Auth-level is the pivotal question. Gate evidence flags auth_consistent low for CRITICAL claims. Session 26 applied correct downgrades. Resolution requires Tier 1 evidence: human must inspect actual add_action() registration for upload handler and confirm which line contains the wp_handle_upload call.
conflict_resolutions.tier: Tier 1 required — gate scores and reasoning alone insufficient to resolve

gate_cross_reference: All 6 UNCERTAIN findings have path_reachable=0.25 due to DI-27-01 (Phase 1 shallow extraction — same root cause as backwpup). S5 confirms reasoning quality varies: a1-002 is strong, a4-review LFI is structurally sound but auth-uncertain, CRITICAL findings have coherence failures. Gate UNCERTAIN is correct for all 6. S5 does not change gate outcomes — cannot supply missing IR path data.
summary: CartFlows merge set has two hard escalation triggers: agent-b absent (coverage gap unknown) and auth-mismatch conflict cluster on the two CRITICAL upload findings. The CRITICAL findings (cf-c-anom_5, cf-c-anom_35) have reasoning coherence failures — missing/unverified sinks, reasoning scores at 0.52, auth claims contradicted by gate. Session 26 downgrades to REVIEW were correct and should hold. The HIGH finding (a4-review LFI) is the most structurally sound high-severity item but remains UNCERTAIN. The LOW finding (a1-002 user enumeration) has strongest evidence profile and is closest to actionable. Overall confidence is limited until auth-level on upload handler is resolved by human inspection and agent-b gap is addressed.
